### FIA Data

Apart from some conceptual linkages to inventory cycles and annual periods,
the Data and Methods section has focused exclusively on the development of notation
for describing the micropanels and macropanels prescribed by the annual FIA sample 
design, and versions of them modified to represent 3 VAE scenarios. However, 
the purpose of the micropanel and macropanel structures is to schedule, in
particular field season years, measurements 
of forest attributes at the locations they contain.
